svg.title: MSGF other side map
svg.text: MSGF · the other side, the borderland pockets and the seams (Part One)

Stylised, not to scale. Positions on the other side are decided here so Part One reads consistently; Part Two (THE OTHER BANK) may redraw the edges. Facts come from STORY_BIBLE.md, PART_ONE_BEATS.md and the scripts.
where the companions come from; reached only by contact windows (invitations)

From the landing: river from upper right to lower left; the shelf follows it
upstream. Walking upstream: water LEFT, wall RIGHT (ch63; ch71's "looking
downstream" should read upstream). Old signal posts above flood lines
("same hand", ch66). Predator in B (ch69–71); the shot (ch78); Ilan's
cylinder in the debris (ch79). Staging outside: a riverside cutting (ch63, 71).

Outer frames carry bolt-on steel knock plates: two knocks on A,
three answer (ch93 hook). The A/B pair is an outside relay, not
a tunnel between pockets. Pocket skies: not given in any script.
Bus stop on the access road: Nib meets Taeo off the bus (ch96).
